event.title: docs: tell the Predictable agent to keep the specs and not fix defects
event.author: gorkma
event.body:
## Summary

After each push to `main`, the Predictable Code agent reads `MAINTAINING.md` at the root, when it exists, and follows it before its default duties. This adds that file with one decision: the agent keeps the specs and stops proposing defect fixes.

```diff
 on(push to main)
   analyse main
+  read MAINTAINING.md
   bring the specs in line with the code      # stays
-  fix the defects the analysis reports
+  leave every defect to a person
```

The file also keeps two rules that already hold in this repo: specs only for the four analysed code folders (`src`, `mcp`, `scripts/render`, `scripts/runtime`), and specs that state only what the code does.

## Evidence

- **Before:** on 26 November the agent ran four times after a push and opened fix and spec pull requests on its own. #6 needed a correction before it could merge; #8 was closed because a review found 11 false and 39 overstated claims in its 283.
  **After:** not measured yet. The file is an instruction to a model, not a switch: the first agent run after this merges shows whether it holds.
- The agent's own instructions name this file: "If the repository has a `MAINTAINING.md` at its root, read it first and follow it: it is how this repository asks to be maintained."

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Delete the file and the agent goes back to its defaults.

**Blast Radius:** tooling

No code, test or published file changes. Only the Predictable agent reads this file.

reason: Pull request opened is not an event the agent reacts to
